cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 86 since 2010. Elected House Majority Leader in February 2026. Chairs the House Health Committee. Served on the Dothan City Commission 2005-2010. Former executive director of Wiregrass Rehabilitation Center; works as a salesman for WDHN-TV.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Paul Lee was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. We found no bills he sponsored, no actions in office, and no statements on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, guns, abortion, policing or schools. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. We found no stated positions on data centers or development, no documented controversies, no foreign ties and no notable endorsements of him. His education is only partly documented: Ballotpedia says he attended Wallace State Community College.
